title: CharacterBakedDefinition
description: Authoritative schema for a baked character asset. Produced by the baker crate from a CharacterSourceDefinition + frame blobs. Consumed by the game runtime (WASM) and the engine sprite registry. This is derived data — never hand-edited.

id.description: Character identifier. Matches the source definition id.

atlas.description: Relative path to the atlas PNG from the assets root. E.g., 'characters/hotdogguy.png'.

spriteSize.description: Width and height of each sprite cell in the atlas.

frameDuration.description: Default seconds per frame for animation playback.

animations.description: Map of animation key to atlas position. Key format: '{animation}_{direction}' (e.g., 'idle_south', 'walk_east'). This is the sprite registry lookup key used by the WASM runtime.

weaponDefId.description: Optional weapon/object reference, passed through from source.

throwableDefId.description: Optional throwable/object reference, passed through from source.

row.description: Row index in the atlas (0-based). Each row contains frames for one animation+direction.

frames.description: Number of frames in this row. Frames occupy columns 0..frames-1.
